as_is_evidence: The draft policy says it applies 'where appropriate', names no accountable role, and sets no review cycle. No approval date is recorded.
to_be_reason_and_date: A written, approved policy is needed before a publisher audit can be answered; by 2026-12-31.
first_action: Fix the draft with the policy review checklist, then get the sponsor to approve it.

as_is_evidence: apps.csv has no owner column, and the council draft names no sponsor.
to_be_reason_and_date: Renewals cannot be decided without an accountable owner for each application; by 2027-03-31.
first_action: Add an owner field and assign an owner to each of the 60 applications.

as_is_evidence: One list exists with cost, users, and data sensitivity for 60 applications. It has no owner and no stated refresh schedule.
to_be_reason_and_date: The list is the base for every other dimension; by 2027-03-31.
first_action: Name apps.csv the record of authority and set a quarterly refresh.

as_is_evidence: The policy and the council charter both require a request form. Nothing shows how many purchases use it.
to_be_reason_and_date: Unplanned purchases are the main source of duplicates; by 2027-06-30.
first_action: Count the share of software bought through the form, as the charter proposes.

as_is_evidence: apps.csv has no lifecycle state or review date.
to_be_reason_and_date: Each application needs a state and a review date before renewals can be tied to a need; by 2027-06-30.
first_action: Add a lifecycle state and a next-review date to the inventory.

as_is_evidence: licenses.csv records entitlements and expiry dates. 2 of 60 licenses were already expired on 2026-09-01. No notice period or auto-renew field exists.
to_be_reason_and_date: Missing notice deadlines turn into silent renewals; by 2026-12-31.
first_action: Start the renewal calendar for every license expiring in the next 180 days.

as_is_evidence: Annual cost and user count are recorded for each application. No keep, change, or retire call is recorded.
to_be_reason_and_date: Duplicate spend is the largest saving available; by 2027-03-31.
first_action: Run the rationalization method and record a decision for each duplicate pair.

as_is_evidence: Data sensitivity is recorded for all 60 applications. The 6 AI systems each have a named owner and a description. No risk tier is recorded.
to_be_reason_and_date: AI systems that touch organizational data need a tier before approval; by 2027-03-31.
first_action: Tier each of the 6 AI systems with the AI intake method.

as_is_evidence: 2 of the 10 retired devices in devices.csv have no wipe confirmation.
to_be_reason_and_date: Unwiped devices are a data risk; by 2026-12-31.
first_action: Hold those 2 devices open and complete the retirement sign-off checklist.

to_be_reason_and_date: Leaders cannot fund what they cannot see; by 2027-06-30.
first_action: Pick five measures, set a baseline, and issue the first leadership report.

to_be_reason_and_date: Owners must know their duties before ownership is enforced; by 2027-06-30.
